_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV decroissante restaurant-growth-driven: nombre restaurants CAVA (croissance unite-driven), Same Restaurant Sales Growth (croissance organique), AUV (productivity unite), Restaurant-Level Profit Margin (rentabilite operating), Digital Mix (channel premium recurring).

kpis.signal: Plus important driver de CA, objectif 1000 restaurants d'ici 2032, croissance organique greenfield
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de restaurants CAVA en operation fin FY24 (29 decembre 2024) dans 25 etats + DC. Objectif 1000 restaurants aux US d'ici 2032. Net New Openings FY24: 58 (vs 72 FY23, 73 FY22).
kpis.description_en: Total CAVA restaurants in operation end FY24 (December 29, 2024) across 25 states + DC. Target 1000 restaurants in US by 2032. Net New Openings FY24: 58 (vs 72 FY23, 73 FY22).

kpis.signal: Best-in-class fast casual, decompo FY24: traffic +8.7% + price +4.7%, comparable Chipotle a son apogee
kpis.description_fr: CAVA Same Restaurant Sales Growth FY24, 13.4% (decomposition: traffic +8.7%, price/mix +4.7%). Performance best-in-class fast casual segment. Calcul sur restaurants ouverts >= 365 jours.
kpis.description_en: CAVA Same Restaurant Sales Growth FY24, 13.4% (breakdown: traffic +8.7%, price/mix +4.7%). Best-in-class fast casual segment performance. Calculated on restaurants open >= 365 days.

kpis.signal: AUV $2.865M parmi les plus eleves fast casual US, prouve traction concept Mediterranean
kpis.description_fr: CAVA Average Unit Volume FY24, $2,865K. CA moyen par restaurant ouvert toute la periode trailing 13 periodes + digital kitchens. Niveau eleve vs concurrents fast casual ($1.5-2.5M typique).
kpis.description_en: CAVA Average Unit Volume FY24, $2,865K. Average revenue per restaurant open entire trailing 13 periods + digital kitchens. High level vs fast casual peers ($1.5-2.5M typical).

kpis.signal: 25% restaurant-level margin parmi les meilleurs fast casual, sales leverage + scale CAVA
kpis.description_fr: CAVA Restaurant-Level Profit Margin FY24, 25.0%. CAVA Revenue moins food, beverage, packaging costs, labor, other operating, occupancy. Levier sales et scale matieres premieres.
kpis.description_en: CAVA Restaurant-Level Profit Margin FY24, 25.0%. CAVA Revenue less food, beverage, packaging costs, labor, other operating, occupancy. Sales leverage and ingredient scale.

kpis.signal: 1/3 du CA en digital (pickup, livraison, catering), levier de fidelisation et data customer
kpis.description_fr: CAVA Digital Revenue Mix FY24, 36.4%. Part du CA generee par commandes digitales (app, web, pickup, delivery, catering). Augmentation continue, +190 bps depuis FY22 (34.5%).
kpis.description_en: CAVA Digital Revenue Mix FY24, 36.4%. Share of revenue from digital orders (app, web, pickup, delivery, catering). Continued increase, +190 bps since FY22 (34.5%).

kpis_story: CAVA combine croissance unite spectaculaire (164 a 367 restaurants en 4 ans), comp sales best-in-class 13.4% FY24, AUV record $2.865M, margins 25% au niveau Chipotle peak. Objectif 1000 restaurants 2032 implique 8 ans de croissance unite-driven.
_notes: Net New Openings FY22 73 (= 237-164). FY21 count infered: 237-73=164 (vs FY21 file inaccessible). Restaurant-Level Margin FY22 du 10-K FY24 (was 20.3%). Toutes valeurs extraites tables Key Performance Indicators de 10-Ks. ANTI-INVENTION: aucune extrapolation.
